description: Create public and admin API endpoints for TopicHub, then mount the routers in main.py. Also integrate TopicHub into the content publisher (Vertex Search indexing) and the chat service (RAG enhancement).
steps: Create apps/backend/app/api/v1/topics.py with a public APIRouter (no auth). Endpoints: (1) GET /topics/{topic_slug} - full TopicHub data by slug, with optional query param chapter_id to disambiguate. (2) GET /topics/{topic_slug}/mcqs - returns MCQs list. (3) GET /topics/{topic_slug}/pyqs - returns PYQs list. (4) GET /topics/{topic_slug}/related - returns knowledge graph neighbors via knowledge_graph_service.get_related_topics(). (5) GET /topics/{topic_slug}/study-path - returns prerequisite chain via knowledge_graph_service.get_prerequisite_chain(). All endpoints return 404 if TopicHub not found.

Create apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin_topics.py with admin APIRouter. Use _validate_admin_session and _csrf_check from app.api.v1.admin. Endpoints: (1) POST /admin/topics/generate-hub - takes chapter_id and topic_slug, creates TopicHub from existing Topic in Chapter.published_topics, returns created hub. (2) POST /admin/topics/{hub_id}/generate-mcqs - calls authority_generator_service.generate_mcqs(). (3) POST /admin/topics/{hub_id}/generate-relations - calls authority_generator_service.generate_topic_relations() or knowledge_graph_service.auto_generate_relations(). (4) POST /admin/topics/{hub_id}/add-source - accepts TopicSource data and appends to the hub's sources list.

Modify apps/backend/app/main.py: import topics and admin_topics routers, add app.include_router for topics (prefix='/api/v1/topics', tags=['Topics']) and admin_topics (prefix='/api/v1/admin', tags=['Admin Topics']).

Modify apps/backend/app/services/content_publisher.py: in publish_to_vertex_search(), after indexing chapter topics, also query TopicHub documents for the chapter and index them with the enhanced metadata schema (title, content, mcq_count, pyq_count, sources, related_topics, key_points, hierarchy, difficulty, importance, has_formula, has_diagram, is_topic_hub='true').

Modify apps/backend/app/services/chat_service.py: in the build_system_prompt() method, after the context_text is built, add a note that if any context chunk has is_topic_hub='true', include additional context hints about MCQs, PYQ references, and prerequisite suggestions from the chunk metadata.
Verify all new files import cleanly and main.py can be loaded.
acceptance_criteria: apps/backend/app/api/v1/topics.py exists with 5 public GET endpoints
apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin_topics.py exists with 4 admin POST endpoints
main.py imports and mounts both new routers without errors
content_publisher.py includes TopicHub indexing logic in publish_to_vertex_search()
chat_service.py build_system_prompt includes TopicHub-aware context enhancement
